summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared db test helpers to legacy db lib
description:
Because:
- The db test helpers and SQL fixtures test the legacy db lib but lived in fxa-shared.
- admin-server jest resolved lib aliases from nest build output, which has no testing/ helpers or .sql files.

This commit:
- Moves the helpers and .sql fixtures to the legacy db lib under src/lib/testing.
- Points admin-server and the fxa-shared db specs at the deep testing paths.
- Keeps testing/ out of the lib build and removes the fxa-shared test export.
- Adds chance and @types/chance to the root devDependencies.
- Maps the testing/ alias to lib source in the admin-server jest config.

Closes FXA-14707
